name: Categorical Ultraviolet
description: A geometric violet/indigo theme with an ultraviolet quantum-cyan accent, designed for a category-theory and mathematical-physics representation library. Evokes commutative diagrams, Yoneda embeddings, and gauge/quantum structure through abstract diagrammatic motifs rather than photographic imagery.
motifs: radial ultraviolet glow behind hero title

gradients.hero: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(167,139,250,0.25), transparent 45%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 30%, rgba(34,211,238,0.18), transparent 40%), linear-gradient(180deg, #0b0818 0%, #100c26 60%, #0b0818 100%)
